sources.title: OpenAI docs: Decisions API guide
sources.notes: Re-read 2026-11-26 by direct curl of the .md endpoint (Mozilla/5.0 UA) with a regex comparison against data/decision-model-catalog/pricing/openai-decisions-api-2026-10.json. Guide now opens: "The Decisions API is now generally available" (public beta at the 2026-10-07 read). Pricing and availability section states: "With gpt-6-luna, uncached input costs $0.10 per 1M tokens. Prompt cache hits receive discounted input pricing; cache writes are charged. Cache-read and cache-write rates match the standard gpt-6-luna prompt caching rates. Output tokens are not charged." and "Regional processing premiums and long-context input pricing multipliers apply." The former sentence "there are no cache-read, cache-write, or output-token charges" is gone. New since beta: prompt caching (implicit breakpoint, 1,024-token minimum prefix), images in question instructions, JSON input, up to 400 questions per request (up from 200), hosted image URLs, conversation history, org usage reporting, GPT-Live integration, Private Link. gpt-6-luna is still the only supported model; no benchmark, latency or calibration number is published.

sources.title: OpenAI docs: gpt-6-luna model page
sources.notes: Re-read 2026-11-26 by direct curl of the .md endpoint; figures compared with the stored decisions-pricing row. Text-token pricing table (standard tier): Input $0.1, Cached input $0.01, Cache writes $0.125, Output $0.5 per 1M tokens. Cross-checked the same day against /api/docs/pricing.md, whose gpt-6-luna standard row matches ($0.10 / $0.50 / $0.01 cached / $0.125 30m write) and adds a 12h cache-write tier at $0.25. "Prompts with more than 272K input tokens are priced at 2x input and cache rates and 1.5x output for the full request." "Regional processing adds a 10% premium where available." Batch/Flex at 50%, Fast at 2x. Context window 1,050,000; max input 922,000. The Decisions guide says Decisions cache-read and cache-write rates match these standard prompt-caching rates; that statement plus this page's printed rates are the source of the decisions row's cache_read_per_m 0.01 and cache_write_per_m 0.125.

Context 64k per-request / 32k per-question; optional long-context raises both to 262k tokens via the TypeSafe-Danger-Zone-Long-Context header at the same per-token price, slower and less accurate. sources.title: OpenRouter docs: Jev
sources.notes: Direct curl + read of the markdown guide. Read 2026-11-26: the guide now centers on typesafe/jev-1.14 (~typesafe/jev-latest alias; typesafe/jev-1.13 still available).
